contract: One light Higgs, three light and five heavy down-type Dirac color triplets, four physical Majorana singlets, MSbar constant-background coefficient at common Q. Vanishing residual local quadratic boundary specified at Q0 for the model selection. Fixed Yukawas and masses to additive one-loop order, common unit transport to the historical curvature. Full pole matching, extra colored scalars and finite quartic/kinetic terms registered separately.
